_comment: Settings for formy3d_backend.py. (live) = seen in the signed-in UI / API on 2026-10-23 (read-only probe, probe/20261023T-signed-in/), (code) = read from the site's client bundle, (unverified) = needs a supervised paid run.
model_status: (live) chip `Tripo3D H3.1` (default) with a select offering `Tripo3D H3.1` and `Tripo3D v2.5`; the backend refuses to run when the chip does not read H3.1
view_slots_status: (live) slot labels Front View (required), Back View, Left View, Right View; same Front/Left/Right/Back mapping as studio.mjs
settings_status: (live) Texture No textures/Standard/HD, Geometry Quality Standard/Detailed, PBR switch (default on), Quad Mesh switch (default off, FBX only). No polycount, topology selector, symmetry or remove-lighting control exists: Quad off = triangle mesh, Detailed = highest detail offered
request_guard_status: (code) the Generate click POSTs /api/demo/gen-3d with pbr / quad / geometry_quality / model; the request is aborted (nothing charged) when those disagree with this config. Field names are from the client bundle and not yet seen on a real request (unverified)
cost_table_status: (live) generate button label 'Generate 3D Model - N' with four views uploaded; download is free (no ledger row); expected_costs.generate must equal the displayed label or --expect-cost N, and budget_credits caps one submit
